name: Delhi Pushpanjali Farms
shortDescription: Pushpanjali Farms, Delhi – Premium Farmhouses for Sale Near IGI Airport & Dwarka Expressway.
longDescription:
Discover premium farmhouses, farm plots and luxury independent properties for sale in Pushpanjali Farms, New Delhi, one of the prominent low-density farmhouse locations near the Delhi-Gurugram border.

The location enjoys excellent connectivity to Indira Gandhi International Airport, Dwarka Expressway, NH-48 / Delhi-Gurugram Highway, Dwarka Link Road and major parts of Delhi and Gurugram. Pushpanjali Farms is particularly attractive for buyers looking for a spacious private residence, luxury farmhouse, weekend home or long-term premium real estate investment.

Pushpanjali Farms provides a peaceful and green environment while keeping residents close to important airport, business, commercial, hospitality and residential hubs of Delhi NCR. The area is known for large-format farmhouse properties and private residences, making it suitable for buyers seeking space, privacy and an exclusive lifestyle.
